extraction.notes: Three months ended 9/30/2022 column (first column) of the FFO/Core FFO reconciliation on seq 15 (printed S-8). No AFFO metric is presented, so AFFO fields are null/empty. The FFO subtotal printed is 'FFO applicable to common shares and Units' (21,039); reported diluted FFO per share ($1.13) is computed on 'Funds from operations applicable to common shares and Units - diluted' (21,199 = 21,039 + 160 preferred dividends) over 18,801 diluted shares and Units; Core FFO diluted (21,622) similarly adds back 160. Reproduced: 21,199/18,801 = 1.13; 21,622/18,801 = 1.15. Ffo_total and core_total are the undiluted subtotals as printed. Classification judgments: 'Technology implementation costs (1)' (two-year software implementation) mapped to severance_restructuring as a software transition; 'Commercial lease termination proceeds' (zero this quarter) mapped to other; 'Interest rate swap termination, amortization, and mark-to-market' mapped to derivative_mtm. Recurring capex: no AFFO section; page seq 22 shows only 'Total Capital Expenditures per Apartment Home – Same-Store' of $465 for Q3 2022 (a per-unit figure, not a company total in thousands), so recurring_capex_disclosed is null.
